evidence.claim: A completed five-minute double-engulfing order block is used for gradual short accumulation, with the final stop fixed at the order-block high.
Buying may be accumulated inside a completed bullish order block only while its low remains the common structural invalidation; entries are planned as scale-in.
Maximum dollar loss is fixed before entry, then total quantity is calculated from weighted-average entry and the common stop; staged entries increase quantity without increasing the maximum loss.
Two distinct entry prices at an FVG and a trend-line retest are planned in advance; if the deeper price is not reached, no second entry is forced.
Two fixed-size passive entries and one preplaced common stop preserve the predeclared risk after both fills; partial profit is taken at overlapping resistance.
